activity_statements.statement: operates an integrated nonprofit health system providing both health insurance and clinical care in Minnesota and Wisconsin
offers health insurance plans for individuals, employers, Medicare, and Medicaid members, covering health, dental, and vision
delivers clinical care through hospitals (including Regions Hospital in St. Paul and Methodist Hospital) and a network of medical group clinics
provides dental care through a network of affiliated dental clinics in the Twin Cities region and beyond
aims to make healthcare affordable and simple by owning both the insurance and care delivery sides, enabling coordination between payer and provider

name_reality_gap: Index label 'Hospitals & Health Care' captures only the care delivery side; HealthPartners is equally a health insurer — its integrated payer-provider structure is the distinctive operational reality that the label misses.
extraction_notes: healthpartners.com/about-us and /hp/health-care/ timed out; homepage provided brief but clear description of the integrated model. Limited detail on hospital system size, premium volume, and clinical program specifics. Confidence is moderate.
